fields.title: 6. Unpublished Runs — Absorption Record Maintained
fields.md:
The 4 unpublished runs injected by the workflow (10/29 · 11/06 · 11/07 · 11/08) have already been reconfirmed and absorbed, with the monthly `2026-11` (10/29) and `2026-11-09-event` (11/06~08) as primary sources. This run does not use the copies as a source. Of each run's facts, those that can be rechecked now — no filings after the latest EDGAR 11/06 8-K (5.02) · Flight 15 LL2 NET 11/13 22:45 UTC (updated 11/10 22:06 UTC) · no search results for a public T7 response — were rechecked and appended to `state.run.unpublished_runs[].absorbed_by`. The 11/08 copy's statement 'Customer A = Google' is not adopted (the 11/09 correction stands — Customer A = U.S. government) (Source: `_probe/unpublished/*.md` · `state.run.unpublished_runs`).
